title: Implement ReportService and ReportController for basic sales reports
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/reports/daily returns daily sales summary (date range filter)
GET /api/v1/reports/products returns sales per product (date range filter)
Reports aggregate from transactions with status 'completed'
Reports include totals (subtotal, discount, tax, total) and item counts
Kasir can access own shift report only
ReportService contains query logic; ReportController handles HTTP
completion_summary: ReportService+Controller: /reports/daily & /products, completed-only, date range, kasir self-scope; void excluded; 4/4 smoke
